description: This source file extends the Foundation.FileHandle class with additional safe read methods, avoiding legacy APIs and Objective-C exceptions.

methods.name: readToEndSafely
methods.description: Reads data until EOF safely using throwing API, returns empty data on failure.

methods.name: readSafely(upToCount:)
methods.description: Reads up to specified count of bytes safely, returns empty data on failure or EOF.
